name: Advanced Elicitation
sequence: Push the model to rethink and improve its latest output through structured critique and refinement.

name: Brainstorming
sequence: Use early in ideation or when stuck generating ideas.

name: Command Hub
sequence: Renamed command router and shortcut registry. Use when you want the BMAD-style command shell with slash commands persona aliases and one-mode routing.

name: Distillator
sequence: Use when you need token-efficient distillates that preserve all information for downstream LLM consumption.
description: adjacent to source document or specified output_path

name: Editorial Review - Prose
sequence: Use after drafting to polish written content.
output-location: three-column markdown table with suggested fixes

name: Editorial Review - Structure
sequence: Use when doc produced from multiple subprocesses or needs structural improvement.

name: Elevate
sequence: Renamed compatibility mode for BMAD-style promote. Use when you want to improve a draft answer plan or artifact with shortcut-driven critique.

name: Expert View
sequence: Run a focused expert-panel analysis with consensus and recommendations. Use when you need specialist viewpoints on a decision artifact or architecture.

name: Ideate
sequence: Renamed ideation mode for brainstorming and option expansion. Use when you want a lighter BMAD-style entrypoint for idea generation.

name: Index Docs
sequence: Use when LLM needs to understand available docs without loading everything.

name: Party Mode
sequence: Orchestrate multi-agent discussions when you need multiple perspectives or want agents to collaborate.

name: Adversarial Review
sequence: Use for quality assurance or before finalizing deliverables. Code Review in other modules runs this automatically, but also useful for document reviews.

name: Edge Case Hunter Review
sequence: Use alongside adversarial review for orthogonal coverage — method-driven not attitude-driven.

name: Shard Document
sequence: Use when doc becomes too large (>500 lines) to manage effectively.

name: Squad
sequence: Renamed collaboration mode for multi-agent discussion and role debate. Use when you want party-mode behavior through a simpler command.

name: Verify
sequence: Renamed compatibility mode for validation and review. Use when you want a strict quality check review pass or artifact validation.
